# Jobby

> Jobby web (https://jobbyweb.vercel.app) is a web app, in Spanish and English, that compares a
> person's CV with a job posting. It returns a match score, an ATS report (keywords found and
> missing, and format checks) and concrete recommendations, and it can rewrite sections of the
> CV for a posting without inventing experience. It has a free plan and a paid plan.

Jobby lets AI search and answer engines read, index and cite its public pages with a link
back, and does not authorize any other automated reuse.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app): what Jobby does and how it works.
- [Pricing](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/pricing): the free and the premium plan and their limits.
- [Guides](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias): the guides below, in Spanish.

## Guides (Spanish)

- [Qué es un ATS y cómo lee tu CV](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/que-es-un-ats): what an applicant tracking system is, what it does with a CV and which format makes it easy to read.
- [Qué es el match score y cómo se calcula](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/que-es-el-match-score): how Jobby computes the match score from six weighted components and how to improve it.
- [Cómo adaptar tu CV a cada oferta](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/como-adaptar-tu-cv-a-una-oferta): step by step, what to read in the posting, what to rewrite and what not to invent.
- [Palabras clave del CV: cómo elegirlas y dónde usarlas](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/palabras-clave-del-cv): how to find the keywords of a posting and how each match counts in Jobby.
- [Cómo hacer un CV compatible con ATS](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/cv-compatible-con-ats): a checklist on format, headings, dates, file and templates.
- [Analizar tu CV con IA: qué puede decirte y qué no](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/analizar-cv-con-ia): what an AI tool can analyze in a CV and its limits.
- [Optimizar el CV con IA sin inventar experiencia](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/optimizar-cv-con-ia): how to rewrite a CV with AI for a posting without adding experience the person lacks.
- [Qué habilidades poner en el CV y cómo ordenarlas](https://jobbyweb.vercel.app/guias/habilidades-para-poner-en-el-cv): which skills to include, technical versus soft, and how much they weigh in the match score.

## What AI agents may do

Allowed, on public pages that need no sign-in:
- Search crawlers that surface the site in their results: OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Claude-SearchBot.
- Fetches a person asks for in the moment: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and Perplexity-User.

Not allowed anywhere in the product:
- Model training, model evaluation, dataset creation, synthetic data generation, bulk
  extraction and any other collection that is not a search index (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot,
  Google-Extended and similar crawlers).
- Redistribution of the content without prior written permission.

Not allowed for any automated agent, search crawlers included:
- Authentication pages, dashboard and onboarding routes, API routes and internal endpoints.
- User profiles, CVs, uploaded documents, job reports, match scores, ATS reports, interview
  kits, billing data, and any authenticated user content.

Contact: developjobby@gmail.com
